l.fairshareModal.banners: The Fair Share Scheduler is not enabled for the selected resource group (). To use the scheduler, please update the resource group settings.
Fair Share settings are organized per resource group according to domain, project, and user hierarchy. To access sub-settings, click an item in the table.
Changes are not immediately reflected in Fair Share calculations and may take approximately 5 minutes due to the calculation cycle.

Upload a CSV to provision multiple user accounts at once.
Upload the CSV file to import. Each row in the file is created as one user account.
These values fill in any field a row leaves blank, so you don't have to repeat them in every CSV cell.
Review the loaded rows before the accounts are created. Flagged errors cannot be fixed here; correct them in your CSV file and upload it again.
At least 1 alphabet, 1 number and 1 special character is required with at least 8 chars.
